scripts.dev: bash -c 'if [ ! -f .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then python3 -m virtualenv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt; fi; (PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 backend/seed.py >/dev/null 2>&1 || true); pgrep -f "uvicorn backend.app.main:app" > /dev/null || (nohup .venv/bin/uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 > /tmp/uvicorn.log 2>&1 & sleep 2) ; exec vite'
